verdict.rationale: Shopify POS is a SaaS point-of-sale product, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions one. The llms.txt file, the Sidekick in-app assistant, POS UI extensions and the GraphQL Admin API are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not an official MCP server an external agent could connect to.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
